method: torchvision MaskRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_V2 (COCO) instance segmentation supplies the person alpha; KeypointRCNN_ResNet50_FPN 17-keypoint pose plus COCO suitcase/backpack/handbag detections drive the walk/stand/luggage/seated classification; every survivor was then hand-audited on a checkerboard contact sheet and truncated, merged or blob masks were discarded by eye. rembg was NOT used - pip install is blocked on this machine by PEP 668 (externally-managed-environment); the Mask R-CNN route replaced it and the OpenCV HOG+GrabCut fallback was therefore not needed. Walking/standing/luggage subjects come from the 부산역 2층 맞이방 walkthrough video: candidates were detected on the 304 extracted 960x540 route6vx frames, then each keeper was re-cut from the matching 1920x1080 video frame (video frame index = N*120-60 for f_N) with the ROI upscaled so the subject is ~760px tall before re-segmentation. Seated subjects come from the real 부산역 2층 bench-row reference photographs, since the walkthrough route never passes occupied seating. Alpha = largest connected component, morphologically closed/opened, eroded 1px and feathered, which removes the semi-transparent matte fringe. RGB receives a gamma exposure lift (target person luma 0.36) so the cutouts read as lit people instead of black silhouettes. The canvas is the tight alpha bounding box resized to 640px tall (512px for the bench-photo seated set), so the subject's feet sit on the bottom edge for ground contact.
